067c36e43530db6512f1ab93066afda4.brief_summary: SDLC is a systematic process for building software that ensures the quality and correctness of the software built . The system development should be complete in the pre-defined time frame and cost . SDLC consists of a detailed plan which explains how to plan, build, and maintain specific software . The output of the requirement phase is a collection of things that are required, and the design phase gives the way to accomplish these requirements . The next step is to implement the design into the development of a software system . Testing determines whether the software is giving the result as per the requirements addressed in requirement phase or not . There are various software development life cycle models defined and designed which are followed during the software development process . These models are also referred as Software Development Process Models . Each process model follows a Series of steps unique to its type to ensure success in the process of software development . Spiral Model is much more complex than other SDLC models . It follows a sequential design process same as the waterfall model . Each phase of SDLC must complete before the next phase starts . The Spiral Model can be time-consuming, as it requires multiple evaluations and reviews . Lean development is based on the principle: create a simple solution, test it with customers, and improve incrementally based on their feedback . LSD focuses on delivering quickly and in small chunks by implementing them in individual iterations . LSD is all about prevent waste, keeping an eye on not sacrificing quality . The Agile Manifesto, created in 2001, sets out the key values and principles behind the Agile philosophy and serves to help development teams work more efficiently and sustainably . Valuing people more highly than processes or tools is easy to understand because it is the people who drive the development process . Methodology uses an iterative and incremental approach that helps the customers to give feedback to Product Increments and satisfy their needs . Flexibility in Agile is also a benefit for the customers as changes can be easily accommodated in the product and the customer need not wait till the whole product is completed . Agile Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) is the combination of both iterative and incremental process . Each iteration of agile SDLC consists of cross-functional teams working on the software . The primary aim of SDLC is to produce high-quality software that fulfils customer requirement . In the Agile method, every project can break down into multiple units that serve an easily manageable process . Enables the team on proper development and testing that reaches a high-quality assurance level . This means every cost is predictable that can be executed within a specified time frame by the team . DevOps and Agile are the two software development methodologies with similar aims, getting the end-product as quickly and efficiently as possible . DevOps is a practice of bringing development and operation teams together . Agile is different from DevOps where developers and Operations team interact and jointly develop a monitoring plan that caters to IT and business needs .
